summary: Scage Future, a Chinese truck and bus body manufacturer reporting on Form 6-K, disclosed the resignation of director Ziqian Guan effective August 21, 2026. The resignation was for personal reasons, with no disagreement with the company and no outstanding compensation or entitlements. This is a routine director departure reported by the issuer, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board change. The filing contains no transaction terms, premium, advisors, or structural details. As a non-US filer, this maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 director resignation disclosure. What to watch: whether a replacement director is appointed and any governance implications.
